gaps.lead: The famine was caused by a long drought.
gaps.explanation: A causes B = A results in B.

gaps.lead: I haven't seen such a good film for ages.
gaps.sentence: It was ___ I had seen for ages.
gaps.explanation: Not…such a good film for ages = the best film (I had seen) for ages.

gaps.lead: 'Can you open the door for me?' she asked me.
gaps.sentence: She asked ___ the door for her.
gaps.explanation: ask somebody TO do something: asked me to open.

gaps.lead: It was unfair of the referee to send him off.
gaps.explanation: shouldn't have + participle criticises a past action.

gaps.lead: When I was a boy, we walked everywhere.
gaps.sentence: When I was a boy, we ___ everywhere.
gaps.explanation: used to + infinitive expresses a past habit.
